formula.description.0: UPHO projects supercell phonon eigenmodes onto the ideal primitive-cell Brillouin zone, then combines projection weights into a wave-vector-resolved phonon spectrum.
formula.description.1: Φ is the second-order force constant, m the atomic mass, κ the atom index, and α and β Cartesian directions. J labels modes at supercell wave vector K. ℓ labels supercells; ṽ includes the Bloch phase at atomic position x.
formula.description.2: k lies in the ideal primitive-cell Brillouin zone, K in the supercell Brillouin zone, and GSC is a supercell reciprocal vector. Multiple primitive-cell wave vectors can correspond to one K.
formula.description.3: N is the number of ideal primitive cells in the supercell; tj are translation representatives. Projection extracts the Bloch component at k. Its squared norm over one supercell ℓ gives the weight. The implementation reduces the projected vector to one primitive cell before evaluating the norm.
formula.description.4: Each mode contributes a weighted peak at its frequency. A Lorentzian replaces the delta peak for plotting. η is the half width at half maximum (HWHM); both examples use 0.05 THz.
formula.description.5: μ labels a little-group irreducible representation at k, dμ its dimension, χ its character, and |Ḡk| the little co-group order. These symmetry weights yield the components in sf_SR.dat.
formula.description.6: The element projector selects components belonging to X. E1 resolves elements, applies translation projection, and takes inner products. Cross terms between different elements in sf_E1.dat may be negative.
formula.description.7: Elemental mode weights are multiplied by the total unfolding weight to obtain sf_E2.dat. This decomposition excludes the element-pair cross terms of E1.
formula.description.8: When star averaging is enabled, spectra are averaged over selected equivalent wave vectors of the ideal lattice. The code divides weights by the star size and sums the components when constructing the spectrum.
formula.description.9: Project ordered Cu₃Au phonons onto the ideal FCC parent lattice and compare weights along an explicitly specified high-symmetry path.
formula.description.10: Unfold a 108-atom disordered alloy supercell onto the ideal FCC primitive cell. Total, symmetry and elemental spectra help examine branch splitting caused by chemical disorder.
parameter.D: Dynamical matrix, determined by force constants and atomic masses.
parameter.κ: κ: atom index within a cell.
parameter.K: K: wave vector in the supercell Brillouin zone.
parameter.k: k: wave vector of the ideal primitive cell.
parameter.Φ: Φ: second-order force constants relating displacement to restoring force.
parameter.x: x: atomic position; in the Lorentzian it denotes frequency offset.
parameter.v: v: mass-weighted phonon eigenvector; a tilde includes the Bloch phase.
parameter.ω: ω: frequency; the KJ subscript denotes an eigenfrequency.
parameter.P: P̂: projector; superscripts specify wave vector, symmetry or element.
parameter.N: N: number of ideal primitive cells in the supercell.
parameter.j: j: index of a translation representative or group operation.
parameter.t: tj is a translation representative; t̂j applies the translation.
parameter.w: w: mode weight; E1 element-pair cross terms are inner products and may be negative.
parameter.A: A: phonon spectrum formed by weighted mode peaks.
parameter.δ: δ: Dirac delta, an ideal peak at an eigenfrequency.
parameter.η: η: Lorentzian half width at half maximum (HWHM); both examples use 0.05 THz.
parameter.d: dμ: dimension of an irreducible representation.
parameter.χ: χ: character of a group operation; * denotes complex conjugation.
parameter.g: ĝj: symmetry operation acting on a mode.
parameter.X: X: chemical element; X′ may denote another element.
parameter.S: S(k): star of symmetry-equivalent wave vectors of the ideal lattice.
parameter.𝒮: S(k): star of symmetry-equivalent wave vectors of the ideal lattice.
parameter.Ḡ: Ḡk: little co-group; vertical bars denote its order.
